draft_body:
Dear KIAB Busan team,

Your 30 September programme notice for the 2026 architecture festival pairs an inclusion/recovery theme with housing and urban architecture forums (https://kiabb.smart-app.co.kr/community/notice/?lhwb_mode=view&board_id=6&list_id=2824).

I am developing Proxy Society’s PhD question about the architectural consequences of AI acting for an absent person. A proposed library/community-centre comparison moves the same delegated handoff between a main queue and a side recess, tracing how waiting, walk-in access and the possibility of staying change.

Could you suggest one Busan architect or scholar working on everyday civic thresholds, or the appropriate forum contact for a short critique? I would like to identify the right person before proposing any meeting or attendance.

Best regards,
Kris Haamer
Proxy Society
https://proxysociety.org/architecture
